title: Positive order from a nonzero coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\iota$ be a type with decidable equality, choose $z\in\iota$, and let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\iota$. If some position $i$ satisfies $a(i)\ne z$, then the number of positions $j$ with $a(j)\ne z$ is positive.
